title: OOP Basics: Classes, Objects aur Constructors
objectives: Class aur object ka farak samajhna

sections.heading: OOP kya hai?
sections.body:
Class ek **blueprint** hai, object uss blueprint se bana asli cheez. Jaise `Product` class ek blueprint hai, aur `Wireless Mouse` ek object.

Laravel poora OOP par bana hai: Controller, Model, Request, sab classes hain. Isliye is lesson ko dhyan se samjho.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Product class
sections.body: Product ke paas data hai (naam, price, stock) aur kaam hain (stock kam karna, availability batana). Data ko **properties** aur kaam ko **methods** kehte hain.

code.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

class Product
{
    public const CURRENCY = 'INR';

    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $name,
        private float $price,
        private int $stock = 0,
    ) {}

    public function price(): float
    {
        return $this->price;
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool
    {
        return $this->stock > 0;
    }

    public function reduceStock(int $qty): void
    {
        if ($qty > $this->stock) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Stock kam hai');
        }

        $this->stock -= $qty;
    }
}

$mouse = new Product('Wireless Mouse', 799.50, 12);
$mouse->reduceStock(2);

echo $mouse->name;        // Wireless Mouse
echo $mouse->isAvailable() ? ' available' : ' out';
echo Product::CURRENCY;   // INR

explain: Constructor ke parameters mein `public`/`private` likhne se woh seedha property ban jaate hain (**constructor promotion**, PHP 8.0+).
`public` – kahin se bhi access. `private` – sirf isi class ke andar. `protected` – class aur uski child classes.
`readonly` – value ek baar set hone ke baad badal nahi sakti (PHP 8.1+).
`new Product(...)` – object banata hai. `->` se property/method milti hai. `::` se constant ya static milta hai.

sections.heading: Static methods
sections.body: Static method object banaye bina class se hi call hota hai. Laravel ke `Route::get()` jaisi calls aise hi dikhti hain (asal mein woh Facades hain, jo aage seekhenge).

code.code:
<?php

class Slugger
{
    public static function make(string $text): string
    {
        return strtolower(str_replace(' ', '-', trim($text)));
    }
}

echo Slugger::make('Laravel Routing Guide'); // laravel-routing-guide

callout.text: Rule of thumb: properties ko `private` rakho, aur zarurat ho to hi `public` method do. Isse object ka data safe rehta hai.

versionDiff.heading: PHP 8.2 aur 8.3 ke OOP features
versionDiff.intro: Laravel 11/12 minimum PHP 8.2 maangte hain, Laravel 13 minimum PHP 8.3. Isliye kuch OOP features sirf naye PHP par milte hain.

items.11: PHP 8.2+: `readonly class` available. Typed class constants (8.3) tabhi use karo jab pakka PHP 8.3 ho.
items.13: PHP 8.3 guaranteed hai, to typed class constants (`public const string X`) aur `#[\Override]` safely use kar sakte ho.

errors.cause: `readonly` property ko object banne ke baad badalne ki koshish.
errors.fix: Naya object banao, ya property se `readonly` hatao agar badalna zaroori hai.

errors.cause: Class ke bahar se `private` property padhi.

errors.error: Typed property must not be accessed before initialization
errors.cause: Typed property ko value diye bina padha.
errors.fix: Constructor mein value set karo ya default value do.

debug.body: Object ke andar kya hai dekhne ke liye `var_dump($obj)`. Type check ke liye `instanceof` aur `get_class()`.

tasks: Constructor promotion se `name` (readonly) aur private `marks` (array) rakho
`grade(): string` method mein `match` ya `if` se grade return karo
Do students ke objects banakar result print karo

options: Constructor parameters ko seedha properties banana
quiz.why: Parameter ke saath `public`/`private` likhne se property apne aap ban jaati hai.

quiz.q: `private` property kahan se access hoti hai?
quiz.why: `private` sirf declare karne wali class ke andar visible hota hai.

quiz.q: `readonly` property ke baare mein sahi kya hai?
options: Ek baar set hone ke baad badal nahi sakti
quiz.why: `readonly` PHP 8.1 se hai aur value ek baar hi set ho sakti hai.

interview.a: Class blueprint hai, object uska instance (asli cheez) jo `new` se banta hai.
`public` sab jagah, `protected` class aur child classes mein, `private` sirf usi class mein.
Properties declare karne aur constructor mein assign karne ka boilerplate kam hota hai.
Jab object ki state ki zarurat na ho, jaise helper ya factory methods. Zyada use se testing mushkil hoti hai.
Current object ka reference, jisse class ke andar properties aur methods access karte hain.

summary: Class blueprint hai, object uska instance.
`readonly` (8.1+), `readonly class` (8.2+) aur typed constants (8.3+) naye PHP ke features hain.
